newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara 91-day bill average yield 6.672 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara 91-day bill average yield 6.672 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank on Tuesday said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.672 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on August 20 for a similar amount, the bids accepted were at an average yield of 6.676 percent.
Bank Negara said the bids were in a high/low range of 6.69/50 percent against 6.69/595 at the previous auction.
Payment for the issue is on Wednesday. The issue will roll over a maturing 500 million ringgit Bank Negara bill.
